intro.title: Practicing the Way
intro.body: A free set of resources from John Mark Comer's Practicing the Way, built around being with Jesus, becoming like Him, and doing as He did. A great next step after a day about life WITH Jesus.

items.title: The Course
items.summary: A free eight-session introduction to spiritual formation. Great to go through with your small group or a few friends.

items.title: The Practices
items.summary: Nine core spiritual practices for building your life around time with Jesus.

items.title: Rule of Life Builder
items.summary: Create your own personal set of practices and rhythms for following Jesus in everyday life.

items.title: Spiritual Health Reflection
items.summary: A guided check-in on where you are with God right now.

items.title: The Book
items.summary: Practicing the Way by John Mark Comer, a short, readable book on becoming more like Jesus.

items.title: Podcasts
items.summary: Long-form conversations with spiritual formation leaders.
